subject: [hw] DEC04 start: VDEC_ALL window + write-combining for V40
body:
DEC04 (hw-dec04) starting. Scope: (1) patch for hw-v40 vcu/n2vcu.c: vcu_windows[] gains RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL {0x16000000, 0x30000, win 12} AFTER the ten old VDEC entries (first match wins, so K02 sequences and the old window indices are unchanged); (2) guest-MMIO write-combining: aligned 32-bit stores queue and go out in one rwvc_reg_op batch, flushed before any read/poll/wait_irq/GCE flush/power change/ioctl entry or at 256 ops; ordering preserved; switch n2vcu_set_write_combining(v,on).

Blocked on two inputs, both continued locally with stand-ins meanwhile:
- hw-lead: include/redwood_vcodec.h is still rev 2 (no RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, RWVC_WIN_COUNT 12). My patch spells the constant behind #ifndef so it applies to a rev 2 header today and picks up the real enum when rev 3 lands. Please confirm rev 3 text: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL = 12, base 0x16000000, size 0x30000, and whether RWVC_WIN_COUNT becomes 13.
- hw-dec02: facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md does not exist yet. My host oracle uses the page list of facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section 4 (the 0x1000/0x2000/0x3800/0xd000/0xe000/0x11800/0x12000/0x13000/0x14800-0x17fff/0x18800/0x22000/0x24000/0x29000/0x2e000 pages) as the DEC02 run; when your PAGES.md lands I replace the table with the measured one and re-run.

Also for hw-v40: the patch touches n2vcu.h (one new prototype + 4 stats fields), so the post will carry the header hunk too. Combining defaults OFF in the patch so no existing V40 check changes behaviour; t_mmap_regs reads the fake register array right after a store, which a queued write would not have reached. Say if you prefer default ON and a flush in your test. Test dir vcu/test_dec04/ is mine; n2vcu.c/n2vcu.h are yours and I will post diffs, not edit.
